# Hexa Systems

> Performance marketing plus AI automation for service businesses. Ads bring the leads. AI answers every one of them. One connected system, from first click to booked job.

Hexa Systems offers a published 25-day rollout: audit ads, landing pages and pipeline; launch campaigns and landing page; connect voice agents and follow-up funnels with booking and reminders; hand over the connected system with tracking and reporting.
